info.title: AIA Calculator API - fullcam
info.description: Emissions Calculators for various farming activities

schema.description: Supply inputs for a FullCAM simulation. The details of land use activity are supplied in a simplified format, and the areas are passed to the FullCAM API and simulated for the user. Results from FullCAM are then returned, ready for emissions calculations
